content.short: Woop Pay simplifies cryptocurrency payment requests by generating payment links.
content.description: Woop Pay addresses a common Web3 UX gap in payment requests by eliminating the need to copy-paste wallet addresses and reducing the risk of transaction errors. Many wallet receive features aren't open source and don't prioritize the end-user workflow. Woop Pay is an open-source solution that lets you create, share, and pay cryptocurrency payment requests in a straightforward, streamlined way, improving clarity and reliability for both payers and recipients.
content.meta: Woop Pay is a Web3 wallet tool that streamlines crypto payment requests with payment links. Discover Woop Pay and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
